$comment: Conformance vectors for GET /v1/revocations/published. Each vector is the exact body the Registry returns for the described state. The `signature.value` field is environment-dependent (depends on the Registry's signing seed) and is therefore replaced with the placeholder `<env-dependent>` — verifiers compare envelope SHAPE here, and re-derive + verify the signature against the live Registry's published key in their conformance harness.

vectors.name: empty_feed
vectors.description: No published revocations yet. Envelope MUST still be well-formed and signed.

vectors.name: two_entries_ordered
vectors.description: Two published revocations, ordered by revoked_at DESC. Tiebreaker is id DESC.
